title: SCA Minhag of the Week 217: "Introduction to Engagements: Part 2"

chapters.title: The Jehaz and engagement
chapters.about: The trousseau and being considered engaged

summary: Mr. Mosseri continues discussing engagements in Haleb, focusing on matchmaker brokers called Hata and the negotiation process known as Basra. He describes the family meeting with the Haham to finalize terms, write a contract, and discuss the trousseau called the Jehaz.
questions: Who were the Hata in Haleb?
What took place at the meeting of the family with the Haham?
What was included in the engagement contract?
